metadata.description: Film SiO2; Deposited by e-beam evaporation on c-Si at 300 °C; 801.9 nm thick film with an amorphous (very fine polycrystalline) dense structure; Heterogenous data processing combining ellipsometric and spectrophotometric measurements; Room temperature.
